A few quick answers

Before we say hello.

What does your process look like?

Listen first. Define the right challenge. Explore a focused direction together, then design, build and refine with regular check-ins.

How long does a project take?

A brand project usually takes 6–10 weeks; a website typically takes 10–16. We agree a realistic schedule after discovery.

Do you work with startups?

Absolutely. We work with early-stage teams and established organisations, shaping the scope around the next meaningful milestone.

What is your minimum budget?

Our sample project engagements start at $10,000. Smaller consultations can be scoped separately.

Can you sign an NDA?

Yes. Share the confidentiality requirements before sending sensitive details. This demo accepts no real submissions.
